_comment: AUTHZ-008: de-brand and re-home the shared embedded Cedar PDP adapter from the frozen libs junk-drawer into the ADR-0562 iam capability. ADR anchors: ADR-0562 §2/§10.22 says iam absorbs identity + authorization + embedded Cedar PDP; ADR-0536 D-2 says Cedar is the in-process embedded PDP engine; ADR-0243 forbids two decision algorithms. Target follows ADR-0562 naming: iam/<face>/<leaf> with cargo iam-<leaf>; the Cedar engine is a transient implementation adapter, so it homes to iam/adapters/pdp-cedar.
